combo_label: Fruit & Veg × At the Art Gallery × Vikings

entries.clue: Crunchy taproot dangled before donkeys and given to snowmen for a nose
Generations-long prose epic of feuds, farms and voyages
No vase, no view, no face: colour and shape alone
Raider whose countrymen held England's north and east under their own law
Stretched, primed cloth awaiting its first mark
Curved yellow fruit sold by the hand, spotty when past its best
Warrior who charged in a howling trance, armour disdained
Viking-age memorial slab, its message spelled in angular staves
Prized green spears bundled up for a fleeting spring season
Keeper who decides what hangs where this season
Linseed-bound medium the Old Masters left months to dry
Perfectly ready to eat, like a pear yielding at the thumb
